observable_outcome: The Foundation Repository has a versioned, machine-verified Release Contract baseline. contracts/release-contract/foundation.json declares release 0.1.0-baseline with exactly twelve mandatory user-facing capabilities, every one at status preview with empty evidence_ids, and contracts/release-contract/foundation-capabilities.json declares, for each of those twelve ids, the seven items required by docs/architecture/release-contract.md section 2 plus the references required by docs/architecture/documentation.md section 5. A new schema contracts/schemas/capability-declaration-set.json with valid and invalid fixtures makes the declaration set a first-class contract, while contracts/schemas/release-contract.json and its two fixtures stay byte-identical. go test ./internal/contracts -run TestFoundationReleaseContractBaseline proves schema validity, capability-id bijection, the unexercised-baseline invariants, the anti-fabrication invariants, anchor and path resolution, and that every make target named in verification exists. internal/release.CompileContract, which today cannot parse any schema-valid Release Contract, compiles the baseline file and reports Version 0.1.0-baseline and the twelve capability ids, and it refuses a capability that claims stable with no evidence id. docs/preview/capabilities.md carries one resolvable anchor per capability recording that the capability is unexercised, and docs/preview/index.md, docs/preview/stable-diff.md and docs/stable/index.md point at the baseline instead of restating it. devbox run --pure check passes.
acceptance_criteria: A1. contracts/release-contract/foundation.json validates against contracts/schemas/release-contract.json with schema_version v1, id rc-foundation-0.1.0-baseline, kind release-contract, created_at RFC3339, correlation_id v2-009-release-contract, release 0.1.0-baseline.

A2. foundation.json capabilities is exactly these twelve objects, in this order, each with status preview and evidence_ids []: cap-repository-registration (Repositoryを登録する), cap-requirement-intake (課題を登録する), cap-backlog-visibility (Backlogを見る), cap-autonomous-resolution (問題解決を自律実行する), cap-human-input-request (人間の入力を求める), cap-preview-operation (Previewを運用する), cap-stable-promotion (Stableへ昇格する), cap-loop-control (ループを制御する), cap-loop-self-update (ループ自身を更新する), cap-shared-resource-allocation (Backlogへ共有資源を配分する), cap-provider-operation (AI Providerを利用・切替する), cap-user-documentation (利用者文書を読む). Each name is derived from the matching docs/product/user-facing-spec.md section 4 subsection; no capability is an internal function or a test case.

A3. foundation.json verification is exactly ["devbox run --pure check", "make component-contracts", "make component-release", "make ownership", "go test ./internal/contracts -run TestFoundationReleaseContractBaseline", "go test ./internal/release -run TestCompileFoundationBaselineContract"] and rollback is {"procedure": "git revert the commit that introduced contracts/release-contract/, then run devbox run --pure check; the known recovery point remains the v1 loop on the main branch as recorded in docs/stable/index.md", "target": "main-v1"}. No Preview-exercise or deployment command appears in verification.

A4. New schema contracts/schemas/capability-declaration-set.json: type object, additionalProperties false, required [schema_version, id, kind, created_at, correlation_id, release, contract_ref, capabilities]; schema_version const v1; kind const capability-declaration-set; created_at format date-time; release pattern ^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+(-[A-Za-z0-9.-]+)?$ ; capabilities type array minItems 1.

A5. Each capabilities item: type object, additionalProperties false, required [id, name, user_action, observable_result, preview_exercise, external_dependencies, outcome_conditions, evidence_retention, documentation, owner_surfaces, evidence_schema, promotion_prerequisites]; optional exercise_ref. external_dependencies: object, additionalProperties false, required [systems, providers, scopes], each a string array. outcome_conditions: object, additionalProperties false, required [success, failure, rollback], each a non-empty string. evidence_retention: object, additionalProperties false, required [location, retention]. documentation: object, additionalProperties false, required [preview], optional stable. owner_surfaces: string array minItems 1. promotion_prerequisites: string array minItems 1. Every string uses minLength 1.

A6. The new schema uses only JSON Schema keywords that internal/contracts.Validate supports: const, enum, type, required, properties, additionalProperties false, minItems, items, minLength, maxLength, pattern, format. It must not use uniqueItems, maxItems, oneOf, anyOf, allOf, not, dependentRequired, patternProperties or prefixItems.

A7. No file under contracts/schemas contains the substrings password, credential, raw_prompt or raw_provider_output; the least-privilege scope field is named scopes and carries scope names only, never any value.

A8. contracts/fixtures/valid/capability-declaration-set.json validates and contracts/fixtures/invalid/capability-declaration-set.json fails validation under internal/contracts.Validate; the invalid fixture fails by omitting required fields and by breaking the kind const and the release pattern, not by relying on an unsupported keyword. TestSchemasAndFixtures in internal/contracts/contracts_test.go picks both up automatically.

A9. contracts/release-contract/foundation-capabilities.json validates against the new schema, has id cd-foundation-0.1.0-baseline, kind capability-declaration-set, release 0.1.0-baseline, contract_ref rc-foundation-0.1.0-baseline, and declares exactly the twelve capability ids of A2 in the same order.

A10. Each declaration is grounded in the canonical product documents: user_action and observable_result restate the matching docs/product/user-facing-spec.md section 4 subsection in one or two sentences each; preview_exercise describes the Preview-environment journey per docs/architecture/validation.md section 3 without claiming it has run; external_dependencies.systems is drawn from the real dependencies (GitHub, Git, Google Cloud Run, Firestore, owner UI, local Runner machine, OS process) and providers from codex, claude, opencode only where the capability is provider dependent; outcome_conditions.success/failure/rollback are observable conditions, not test names; evidence_retention.location is .agents/v2/evidence/ with the retention worded as the rollback window from docs/product/user-facing-spec.md section 9; evidence_schema is contracts/schemas/evidence.json.

A11. Every capability's documentation.preview is docs/preview/capabilities.md#<capability id> and documentation.stable is absent for all twelve, because no v2 Stable Release exists. Each promotion_prerequisites array names, at minimum, the Preview real-environment exercise, the affected real external systems and Providers, the stop/rollback/resume evidence, and the publication of the same-version Stable user documentation section, phrased against release-contract.md section 4 conditions 1-8.

A12. Every capability's owner_surfaces entries are either /owner/ or a path literally declared in contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml (for example /v1/requirements, /v1/controls, /v1/queue/summary, /v1/export, /v1/runner/enrollment, /v1/executions/result). A capability with no API path yet uses ["/owner/"] and records publishing its owner API path in promotion_prerequisites. No path is invented.

A13. New docs/preview/capabilities.md contains, for each of the twelve ids in A2 order, a line followed by a short Japanese heading and one or two sentences stating that contracts/release-contract/foundation-capabilities.json is the canonical declaration and that the capability is unexercised (証跡なし) because no Preview Release is deployed. Each anchor string appears exactly once in the file. The file does not restate user_action or observable_result prose from the JSON.

A14. docs/preview/index.md and docs/preview/stable-diff.md each gain a link to docs/preview/capabilities.md and to contracts/release-contract/foundation.json, and docs/stable/index.md gains one sentence recording that no v2 Stable capability exists and that the capability baseline is contracts/release-contract/foundation.json. No existing sentence is deleted and no capability prose is duplicated.

A15. New test internal/contracts/release_contract_test.go, package contracts, function TestFoundationReleaseContractBaseline, reuses the existing helpers ValidateFile, mustRead and readJSON from contracts_test.go and must not redeclare them or any other existing identifier.

A16. TestFoundationReleaseContractBaseline asserts: (a) both instances validate against their schemas; (b) capability ids are unique, non-empty and identical between the two files in the same order; (c) contract_ref equals the contract id and both release strings are equal; (d) baseline invariant: when the release prerelease identifier is baseline, every capability status is preview and every evidence_ids is present and empty; (e) anti-fabrication invariant: a capability with status stable must have at least one evidence id and a documentation.stable value; (f) evidence resolution: every evidence id listed by any capability resolves to an entry id in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json; (g) every documentation.preview and documentation.stable value splits into an existing file path and an anchor that occurs exactly once in that file as ; (h) every evidence_schema path exists; (i) every owner_surfaces entry is /owner/ or occurs in contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml as a declared path; (j) every verification entry whose first token is make names a target present in the Makefile.

A17. internal/release/release.go CompileContract parses the canonical contract surface: the decode struct gains id, kind, created_at, correlation_id, verification, rollback{procedure,target} and, per capability, name, status and evidence_ids, so that DisallowUnknownFields still rejects an unknown field while accepting a schema-valid contract. CompileContract additionally returns an error when any capability has status stable and no evidence id. Its existing behaviour for the minimal JSON used by TestContractAndPromotionGateRejectDriftAndStaleEvidence is unchanged, and internal/release/release_test.go is not edited.

A18. New test internal/release/contract_baseline_test.go, package release, function TestCompileFoundationBaselineContract, compiles the bytes of contracts/release-contract/foundation.json together with the bytes of docs/preview/capabilities.md and asserts Version 0.1.0-baseline and exactly the twelve capability ids of A2 in order, and asserts errors for (a) a contract carrying an unknown top-level field, (b) a contract carrying an unknown capability field, and (c) a capability with status stable and empty evidence_ids. It must not redeclare the existing helper candidate.

A19. ci/components.json adds "contracts/release-contract/**" to the release component's contract_dependencies and changes nothing else; go test ./internal/ci ./cmd/ci-plan and make ownership both pass, and every new file has exactly one owning component.
A20. gofmt reports no files, go vet is clean, and devbox run --pure check prints its passing verdict; the run is judged by the verdict output, not by the devbox exit code.

A21. No Evidence artifact, task-state file or evidence index entry is created or modified anywhere under .agents/, and no capability, verification entry, declaration or document sentence claims that any Preview exercise, Provider connection, deployment or promotion has already happened.
constraints: Work only inside the isolated task worktree on the task branch. Never write to the v2 integration branch and never push; the coordinator is the only writer to v2.

Do not fabricate Evidence: no capability may be given status stable, no evidence_ids may be non-empty, and no file may state that a Preview exercise, real Provider connection, deployment or Stable promotion has occurred.
Do not deploy, promote, or use any Provider or Google Cloud credential; this Work Order performs no external side effect and no network call.
Do not modify contracts/schemas/release-contract.json or its valid/invalid fixtures. If the design appears to require it, stop and escalate instead of editing.

Do not modify internal/contracts/contracts_test.go, internal/contracts/validator.go, internal/release/release_test.go, internal/domain, the Makefile, devbox files or go.mod/go.sum. Add new test files instead of editing existing ones.
Secrets, tokens and scope values must never appear in any file; scopes fields carry scope names only.

Japanese is used for the user-facing document text in docs/preview and docs/stable; the JSON contract instances and the Go test use English identifiers, and Japanese prose is allowed inside declaration string values.

Keep every added JSON file deterministic: stable key order as specified, two-space indentation, no trailing whitespace, terminating newline, and no timestamps other than the created_at values fixed by this Work Order.
Do not add a Go module dependency; internal/contracts must stay dependency-free.

Read only docs/architecture/release-contract.md, docs/architecture/validation.md, docs/architecture/documentation.md, docs/product/user-facing-spec.md, docs/product/definition.md, docs/policies/README.md, contracts/schemas, contracts/fixtures, internal/release, internal/contracts, ci/components.json, contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml, docs/preview and docs/stable; do not restore or read v1 GitHub Issue workflow material.
